# Power Reactor Information System

The Power Reactor Information System (PRIS) is the world’s authoritative source of official data and statistics on nuclear power development and performance. It contains information collected by the IAEA since 1969, providing comprehensive information on reactors in operation, under construction, and in decommissioning. All information and data items are collected by the IAEA through data providers nominated by Member States.

### 2026: Operating Experience with NPP (OPEX) 

Operating Experience with Nuclear Power Stations in Member States 2026 Edition. This report contains the 57th edition of the IAEA’s series of annual reports on operating experience with nuclear power plants in Member States. It is a direct output from the IAEA’s Power Reactor Information System (PRIS) and contains information on electricity production and overall performance of individual plants during 2025. In addition to annual information, the report contains a historical summary of performance during the lifetime of individual plants and figures illustrating worldwide performance of the nuclear industry. The design characteristics and dashboards of all operational nuclear power plants worldwide are also included.
